title: Invariant Structure, Variable Returns: What Survives the Fill Assumption in an Intraday Edge
summary: Owned corrected NG OHLCV exists; exact selection rule, reference level, tolerance and exchange-tape fills are unverified. Do not invent a generic fade.
findings: Abstract claims 85–97% of the advantage comes from entry price and tape-floor advantage of 2.7–3.1 times placebos.
mechanism: Price selection may matter more than entry time; no net executable alpha independently established.
build_on: Owned corrected NG OHLCV exists; exact selection rule, reference level, tolerance and exchange-tape fills are unverified. Do not invent a generic fade.
code_feasibility: Not yet: executable rule and fill contract unavailable; an abstract does not freeze a strategy.
